upsert.title: Adoptive T-cell therapy for canine B-cell lymphoma
upsert.status: Currently offered — confirmed on Aurelius Biotherapeutics official website
upsert.contacts: Aurelius Biotherapeutics — info@AureliusBio.com; (360) 734-0720; 720 Virginia Street, Bellingham, WA 98225
upsert.funding: Clinical service / advanced treatment option; confirm current treatment cost directly with Aurelius.
upsert.notes: Autologous adoptive cell transfer for canine B-cell lymphoma. Peripheral-blood T cells are collected, expanded ex vivo and infused back into the patient. This is not CAR-T and does not genetically engineer the T cells. Treat as an advanced treatment option rather than a recruiting clinical trial unless the patient is enrolled in a specific study.

upsert.title: Oncolytic peptide plus adoptive T-cell immunotherapy for canine B-cell lymphoma
upsert.status: Actively recruiting — Aurelius official website states patients are being recruited for the initial pilot study
upsert.contacts: Theresa Westfall, DVM / Aurelius Biotherapeutics — info@aureliusbio.com; (360) 961-3529 or (360) 734-0720
upsert.funding: Aurelius states the trial is fully funded with no additional expense to owners.
upsert.notes: Initial pilot study combining an oncolytic peptide immunotherapy developed with Lytix Biopharma and Aurelius adoptive T-cell therapy. Official current Aurelius page specifies B-cell lymphoma, previously untreated, Stage III–V(a), with almost all study treatment performed in Bellingham, Washington. Initial treatment requires about three days followed by at least two later visits around one month later. Full eligibility requires investigator prescreening.
